core_obligations: The forward direction: the author states that the if part follows from the author's lemma lem:betasurj, because the case W = 0 is excluded by the assumption W not equal to 0 in this section (proof line 2446-2447).

The reverse direction: since (B,a,b) is zeta-bullet-semistable by the author's lemma lem:face, take its Jordan-Holder filtration in the sense of the author's theorem thm:Rudakov (proof lines 2449-2451).

The grading argument: the submodule V^{k_W+1} would violate zeta-stability unless k_W = N, so for N different from 0 the associated graded gr_0(B,a,b) has W-component 0 and is a 0-stable module for the subgraph I^0 extended to the whole graph by zero (proof lines 2451-2455).

The conclusion: regularity forces that graded module to be S_i for some i in I^0, in particular the corresponding beta_i is not surjective, which is the contrapositive of the stated equivalence (proof lines 2455-2457).
proof_roadmap: 正向：由 lem:betasurj 直接得到，因为本题假设 W != 0 排除了该引理的情形 (a)。
反向：先用 lem:face 得到 zeta-半稳定性，再按 thm:Rudakov 取 Jordan-Holder 过滤；若 N != 0 则 gr_0(B,a,b) 的 W 分量为 0，是子图 I^0 上的 0-稳定模，正则性迫使它是某个 S_i，从而某个 beta_i 不满，反证结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the criterion for the vanishing of the cokernels of the moment maps on a regular point of the quiver variety (author Lemma at source lines 2434-2438, Section 4). The proof (source lines 2445-2457) is short but not routine: after the forward direction is attributed to the author's lemma on the surjectivity of beta_i, the reverse direction has to build the Jordan-Holder filtration supplied by the author's Rudakov theorem, then argue on the associated graded object that the submodule V^{k_W+1} would contradict zeta-stability unless k_W = N, so that for N different from 0 the W-component of gr_0(B,a,b) vanishes and the graded object is a simple module for the subgraph I^0 extended by zero (proof lines 2451-2455); regularity then pins that simple module to some S_i, which makes the corresponding beta_i non-surjective. The statement is the technical heart of the author's description of the strata of M_{zeta^bullet} in the Levi-factor example. H2.
